experiments.title: Walk · pick · place
experiments.summary: Walk → pick → transport → place → withdraw, from RGB-D and tactile estimates. The same frozen controller also passed a static tray-shift and a 200 g payload check. Nominal compensation improves tracking; the matched uncompensated run also completes. Calibrated stationary marker/shape priors; development failures retained.

cam.title: RGB-D camera
cam.description: Calibrated RGB-D workcell camera; warehouse decoration is not part of these sensor frames.

prop.title: Proprioception
prop.description: Joint encoders, IMU, foot contacts and calibrated 3D gripper-pad force measurements. No simulator object identity, payload mass or root position is supplied.

det.title: Visual detection
det.description: Authored RGB-D color segmentation/backprojection estimates the orange item, blue pelvis marker and magenta receiving surface. Colors and sizes are calibration priors; no live simulator target poses.

est.title: Robot belief
est.description: Root estimate combines RGB-D marker, IMU, encoders and contact-based odometry.

bel.title: Object belief
bel.description: Innovation-gated Gaussian object-position estimate. Upright 5 cm cube and square support geometry are supplied priors, positioned by the visual estimate.

plan.title: Geometric targets
plan.description: Geometric approach, grasp, lift, transport, lower and withdrawal targets anchored to visual object and destination estimates. Authored bounded motion; not a learned VLA or global obstacle planner.

guard.title: Contact guards
guard.description: Tracking, contact and destination-freshness guards compose the task. Near the observed receiving surface, sustained load transfer with bilateral contact triggers opening at the measured hand pose, followed by withdrawal. Loss of contact/timeouts abort. Placement success is scored separately from simulator evidence.

ik.title: Bounded arm IK
ik.description: Joint/step-limited damped least squares and sampled tool clearance against known-shape source and destination supports. The recorded solver backend is identified in the evidence; this is local collision checking, not a full-body collision-free guarantee.

walk.title: Frozen RL walker
walk.description: Frozen Unitree locomotion model shared with the earlier retargeting controller.

servo.title: Joint servo
servo.description: Leg and arm joint servos combine target tracking, estimated robot gravity compensation and the tactile payload feedforward torque.

robot.title: G1 robot (sim)
robot.description: MuJoCo G1 physics. Recorded truth is used for scoring and diagnosis only.

destination.title: Destination estimate
destination.description: Stationary, axis-aligned 20 cm magenta marker detected from RGB-D. Visible-extent checks reject cropping; innovations above 12 mm after initialization are rejected. An exponential average smooths accepted measurements. Scene variants may move the tray before a run; this does not track a moving tray.

payload.title: Payload observer
payload.description: Rotates measured pad reactions with estimated robot orientation, gates updates on bilateral contact and slow hand motion, and low-pass filters a bounded vertical payload load. Mass is derived as load/g for diagnosis; no ground-truth payload mass enters.

feedforward.title: Jacobian feedforward
feedforward.description: Estimated payload load produces an arm torque correction through the hand Jacobian transpose. Compensation decays after release; no learned payload model is used.

experiments.title: Contact-guided reach
experiments.summary: planned-height-v1 development replay, raised pedestal (+4 cm). Left: sensor-anchored geometry, bounded IK and contact guards. Right: previous ALG.2 retargeting failure. Later regression outcomes below use a revised controller; this video shows v1. Known-shape local clearance, not global warehouse planning.
